title: Ex11 Stalling — approach the stall, recover; bounds document the c172 low-speed departure

asserts.desc: no wing-drop past ~55 deg (recoverable, whole trace)
no wing-drop past ~55 deg other way (whole trace)
nose-drop within a realistic stall break (> -55 deg)
sink bounded, not a spin dive (whole trace)

_known_defect: OPEN FDM: the Froude-scaled c172 develops a violent low-speed ROLL departure (rolls through inverted, |roll|>150 deg, oscillating) as it approaches/leaves the stall — confirmed present even with TURN_ASSIST removed (so NOT the iteration-1 coordination fix) and only marginally helped by p_factor. A docile trainer should show at most a gentle wing-drop. Root is the low-speed roll dynamics of the scaled c172 (prop reaction torque vs collapsing aileron authority / roll damping). The min_roll/max_roll asserts are the honest bound they violate; tracked as xfail (KNOWN DEFECT), not hidden. Needs dedicated FDM work in c172.xml (roll damping Clp / propulsion torque). See memory critic-loop-state.
